description: This file declares the interface for the PUSCH decoder in a 3GPP LTE/NR implementation, including configuration, decoding method, and softbit handling.

classes.name: ocudu::pusch_decoder
classes.description: Interface class for decoding PUSCH codewords, including configuration and softbit processing.

methods.name: new_data
methods.description: Decodes a PUSCH codeword, returning a buffer for softbit input and outputting the decoded transport block.

methods.name: set_nof_softbits
methods.description: Sets the expected number of softbits for the codeword, enabling early decoding.
